verdict: Paid ads went dark Sep 19; all 90 leads came from the prior three weeks.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 90 leads at $16.11 per lead on $1,449.67 in total spend — but every one of those leads arrived before September 19. Both Meta and Google have been completely inactive for the past seven days, which points to an account or billing event rather than a deliberate pause. While ads were running (September 1–18), the cost per lead held steady and volume was consistent, so the underlying campaign performance was sound. Reactivating both channels is the immediate priority, and several supporting build items — including paid landing pages and a full-stack test — are being closed out in parallel to ensure campaigns relaunch on a stronger foundation. Once ads are back on, lead volume should return to the pre-shutdown pace within days.

cost per lead while campaigns were active
consecutive days with zero paid spend as of this report

watch_item.issue: All paid advertising (Meta and Google) has been offline since September 19 — no new leads are being generated.
